partition_policy: Maximum average original bone-region weight; connected exact ties choose the nearest parent; equal depth uses a stable name order. Explicit surface subdivisions/actual elbow-wrist region recovery are recorded separately.
auxiliary_mesh_policy: Material fragments retain original UVs/images and must be welded only to their named, actual Motor6D-driven R15 part.
limitations: Bone-weight maximum triangles become rigid parts; joint seams and non-adjacent low-confidence weights need motion QA.
Exact bone joint positions use canonical R15 axes; Mixamo bind-pose/roll versus default Animate is not yet verified.
No retargeting or geometry-based replacement is performed.
New barycentric normals are normalized mechanically; the measured small shading-field change needs visual QA.

mechanical_surface_partition.foot_recovery_policy: Only original weighted left-leg triangles entirely on the foot side of the actual knee-to-ankle bone plane; crossing triangles retain their original owner.
